modules.note: whole cell assembled at build time: libcuflynx flat model of cell/generic_adaptive_cell/versions/fermenter merged into one component by aod_kernelgen.flatten (literal units restored from the sources)
modules.per_cell_inputs_note: inputs the game sets per cell (FermenterWorld, FermenterCell): glucose, lactate and H+ at the membrane (H+ also as H_o), the motor, each trait target (clamped per cell to the membrane room) and the growth, storage, repair and matrix controls; every other input is shared by the cells of a group (docs/plans/parallel-and-gpu.md)

modules.note: one volume of the space between cells (level 4); copied from circulatory-autogen-modules branch feat/extracellular-matrix c34eb0b (tools/build_extracellular_space.py) until it is merged upstream and the submodule follows
modules.per_cell_inputs_note: the game makes a copy per gap between three cells (ExtracellularSpace) and sets its volume and the matrix the cells deliver; diffusion between volumes is the game's transport step with the extracellular_face law

modules.note: diffusion between two volumes of the space between cells; the game reads its diffusivities and applies its conductance law in the transport step (ExtracellularSpace.Conductance, checked against this module); copied from circulatory-autogen-modules branch feat/extracellular-matrix c34eb0b (tools/build_extracellular_space.py) until it is merged upstream and the submodule follows
